---
title: "Index"
# sphinx generated a genindex.html of every documented symbol, and this page has
# been linked from the site since 2020. Quarto has no equivalent. The page is
# kept so the old URL does not 404, and because "Index" is still a navbar entry
# -- which is why it explains itself rather than silently redirecting.
---

Sphinx built an alphabetical index of every documented name. The Quarto site
replaces it with two things:

- **Search** — the box in the header searches the full text of every page,
  including the API reference. It is the closest equivalent, and generally finds
  more than the old index did.
- **[API reference](doc/reference/index.html)** — every public function, class
  and method, grouped by task rather than listed alphabetically.
